description: Upstar's search, the same as the site's search bar: topics by whole words (a name, slug, GitHub tag, language or keyword equal to the query, then every word of it in the topic's name, category or description) and every repository with an Upstar page (by name, description, GitHub topics and language; kept-out ones included, blocked ones apart); plain matching, no AI. Repositories: exact name first, then the most stars gained this week.

detail.description: compact (the default): each repository's rank, name, description, language, stars, gains and Upstar page; full adds its creation day, health level, topics with their ranks and GitHub address, list_topics its categories, and get_repo its 12-week history, GitHub topics, activity counts and every period's ranks

lang.description: language of the names, descriptions and links Upstar writes: en (default at /mcp) or fr (default at /fr/mcp); repository descriptions stay as their authors wrote them

limit.description: how many repositories, 1 to 50 (10 by default)

query.description: words to look for: a repository's name or owner/name, a word of its description, a GitHub topic, a language or a topic's name

name: search

data_updated_at.description: when Upstar last rebuilt its rankings from GitHub's data (UTC, RFC 3339): every figure is as of then

lang.description: language of names and descriptions written by Upstar (en or fr)

left_out.description: matching repositories the search does not return: blocked by Upstar, so without a page

matches.description: how many repositories the search finds in all

method_url.description: Upstar's page explaining how stars are counted and repositories ranked

description.description: the repository's GitHub description, as its authors wrote it

health.description: Upstar's health level: healthy, mixed, low, new or archived (full detail; empty when not assessed)

rank.description: its rank in this list (a topic ranking keeps the topic's own ranks)

stars.description: GitHub's star count as Upstar last read it

topics.description: its topics with its rank there this week (full detail)

repos.description: the first matching repositories, best match first (exact name, then name, description, GitHub topic, language; then stars gained this week): the same as the site's search bar

source.description: the source to cite when using these figures

ranked_this_week.description: repositories ranked in it this week

slug.description: the topic's id, for topic_ranking and emerging

topics.description: topics matching the query by whole words, strongest first: slug, name, GitHub tag, language or keyword equal to it; then name and tags; then category; then description; the same as the site's search bar

title: Search Upstar
